description: Client-side script for the 'Loan Application' form in ERPNext, handling form setup, validation, dynamic field toggling, button creation, and pledge calculations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the form, defining make methods.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes form, adds toolbar buttons based on status and security.

methods.name: repayment_method
methods.description: Handles changes to repayment method, resets amounts and toggles fields.

methods.name: toggle_fields
methods.description: Enables or disables repayment amount and periods based on selected method.

methods.name: toggle_required
methods.description: Sets required fields for repayment based on method.

methods.name: add_toolbar_buttons
methods.description: Adds custom buttons for creating loan or pledge if application is approved.

methods.name: create_loan
methods.description: Creates a loan from the application if approved.

methods.name: create_loan_security_pledge
methods.description: Creates a pledge for secured loans.

methods.name: is_term_loan
methods.description: Toggles visibility and requirement of repayment method based on term loan status.

methods.name: is_secured_loan
methods.description: Sets pledge requirement based on whether the loan is secured.

methods.name: calculate_amounts
methods.description: Calculates pledge amounts and total maximum loan amount.
